_comment: Reference of every PiDev/OpenACP setting and where it lives. PiDev reads its settings from .env (see .env.example); this file is documentation, not loaded at runtime.

pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_ALLOWED_USER_IDS: numeric Telegram user IDs; empty = nobody (fail closed). Also written into OpenACP security.allowedUserIds by 'pidev apply openacp'
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_WORKSPACE_ROOT: absolute path; OpenACP instance lives at <root>/.openacp so OpenACP's workspace base == this root
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_LOCK_TTL_MINUTES: idle minutes before a project write lock can be taken over

claude code (root-owned, rendered by 'pi./etc/claude-code/managed-settings.d/50-p: permissions (allow/ask/deny), bypass disabled, guard hook, sandbox
